name: Islen Waterseer
summary: Beside the Tidus Stair, respected tauren shaman Islen Waterseer guides Horde initiates through the trials of water. She lives by a quiet fishing hut and teaches shamans to attune to water spirits as they seek their Water Totem.

sections.title: The Hermit of Tidus Stair
sections.body: On the Barrens coast, Islen Waterseer keeps to the craggy Tidus Stair, where arid plains meet the Great Sea. Water spirits are raw and near along this shore. Islen chooses this quiet outpost over thunderous halls and busy cities, spending her days listening to the tides. Shamans seeking communion with water come to her for guidance.

sections.title: Mistress of the Water Sapta
sections.body: To know water, a shaman needs inner harmony and spiritual sight as well as study. Islen guides seekers in preparing the Water Sapta, a sacred brew that pierces the veil between mortal senses and elemental manifestations. She teaches that water can be unyielding and deep, yet fluid and restorative. Anyone who calls on its aid must show it great respect.

sections.title: Bonds Across the Wilds
sections.body: Though Islen lives quietly on the coast, her spiritual ties reach across Kalimdor. She shares a close, enduring friendship with Greta Mosshoof, another wise tauren skilled in the restorative arts. Islen's knowledge of water's purifying nature reaches beyond the Barrens, bringing spiritual aid to lands afflicted by deep corruption.

faq.answer: Along the Barrens coast, Islen Waterseer guides shamans who seek their Water Totem. The respected tauren shaman has a rare, deep bond with the elemental spirits of water and mentors those who travel to learn from her.

faq.q: Why do shamans travel to see her?
faq.answer: During the Call of Water trials, shaman trainers in Durotar, Orgrimmar, and Thunder Bluff direct their students to Islen. She tests their understanding of water and teaches them to craft the Water Sapta, which lets them perceive water elementals directly.
Islen sits outside a small fishing hut on the Tidus Stair, on the Barrens' eastern shore south of the Merchant Coast.

faq.q: What is the Water Sapta she speaks of?
faq.answer: The Water Sapta is a spiritual draught brewed with elemental components. Drinking it lets a shaman's sight pierce the physical plane and reveal water spirits dwelling in sacred springs and tides.

faq.q: Who is Islen's friend Greta Mosshoof?
faq.answer: Greta Mosshoof is Islen's old tauren companion and fellow practitioner of spiritual crafts. They share an enduring friendship and consult one another about spiritual cleansing and water's restorative nature.

faq.q: Does Islen belong to a specific faction or tribe?
faq.answer: No tribe is named for Islen. She lives alone on the coast and welcomes travelers from both the Horde and the Alliance. She helps cleanse Felwood's corrupted waters, while Horde shaman trainers send their orc, troll, and tauren students to her.

angles.text: As a shaman, you learn from Islen the elemental rites that bind you to water spirits and teach you to commune with them as you seek your Water Totem.
As a tauren, you can see Islen's reverence for the Earth Mother's gifts in her solitary life by the sea, where she stays attuned to the wild's subtle currents.
As a member of the Horde, you find a tranquil spiritual anchor in Islen along the Barrens coast. She welcomes travelers from Orgrimmar and Thunder Bluff.
